The issue has Needs-Author-Feedback and Needs-Triage labels with no assignee.

judgment.recommended_action: Request a complete mapping configuration, keyboard/layout context, and cross-application reproduction.

comment.body:
Please provide enough detail to reproduce the remapping problem:

- A screenshot of the Keyboard Manager mapping showing the source key, target key, and whether it is a key remap or shortcut remap.
- Your physical keyboard model and Windows keyboard layout/language.
- The exact PowerToys version and whether it is running elevated.
- What happens when you press Space after applying the mapping, including the exact character or action observed.
- Whether the mapping works in Notepad, File Explorer, and another application, or fails everywhere.
- Whether other remappings work and whether the issue remains after restarting PowerToys.
- A fresh bug report ZIP captured while the mapping is enabled.
